conflicts_and_limits: Legal compliance applicability and certification need authoritative human or external assessment; source aspiration cannot certify them.
Predictive AI threat neutralization and advanced maturity benefits are unverified expected outcomes.
Penetration tests, research, regulatory engagement and external collaboration require applicable scoped authorization.
Monitoring, personalized training and incident-sharing require privacy and confidentiality decisions.
Simplicity must preserve necessary controls, and source stages do not authorize skipping foundational safeguards.
